title: One shared basic group-theory layer instead of copies in each file
summary: 47 groups of short general lemmas (normalizers, centralizers, scalar products of class functions, Fitting subgroup images, odd cores) are proved again in several files of this folder, 200 copies and about 3,000 lines in all; each group's statement is also proved in five or more files elsewhere in CFSG. The full list with files and names is in /Users/ryuyahora/Codes/refactor-math/out/qz_basic_groups.json.
instructions: For each group in the list, keep one proof: use the Mathlib lemma if one states the same fact (search the Mathlib sources under .lake/packages/mathlib), otherwise put a single copy in a new file CFSG/ThirdParty/QiuzhenCFSG/BasicGroupTheory.lean (imports only Mathlib, or files every user already imports), delete the other copies, and make their users refer to the kept lemma. Copies that are used from outside the folder are protected declarations (listed in data/protected/ThirdParty/QiuzhenCFSG.txt of the concept-mining repository): keep their names, for example as one-line theorems proved by the shared lemma. Work group by group, largest first, and build the changed modules after each group (nice -n 15 lake build <modules>). Partial progress is accepted as long as everything builds and the token count drops.
